info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Financial Instrument Reference Data Management API
info.description: The Financial Instrument Reference Data Management API enables businesses to efficiently manage and update the reference data associated with financial instruments within their banking systems. This API allows users to modify existing data records to ensure accurate and up-to-date information is readily available for financial decision-making. Typical consumers include financial analysts, compliance teams, and trading systems that require constant updates on instrument characteristics. Leveraging this API enhances operational accuracy and supports regulatory compliance in an ever-evolving market environment.

put.description: This endpoint allows users to update the reference data for financial instruments within the market data system. Ensure that the data provided complies with the required format to avoid errors.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update or manage the reference data of financial instruments within the market data system. It should contain the necessary information to identify and modify the respective financial instrument's data as per the requirements specified by the API.

200.description: The request was completed successfully and the operation was applied.
